```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Fairfield' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom), TRUE),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
)
SELECT
  MAX(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS max_slope_degrees
FROM slope_raster;
```
